description: Executable ownership and reproduction map for every node ID in the removal-only unit-gate quarantine.

clusters.rationale: Launcher lifecycle, source resolution, process ownership, and Qt setup contracts drifted together during the hollow-merge period.
clusters.exit_criteria: Every selected launcher test passes in the Green-Suite Unit Gate without UNIT_GATE_QUARANTINE and no replacement node ID is added.
clusters.blocking_status: Requires contract-by-contract launcher repair; do not broadly rewrite Qt lifecycle behavior.

clusters.rationale: Canonical Tools ownership, adapter contracts, workspace registration, and AI service boundaries must be reconciled without recreating vendored implementations.
clusters.exit_criteria: The selected tests pass against the pinned Tools boundary with no shadow implementation or synthetic backend response.
clusters.blocking_status: Coordinate canonical shared-code changes in Tools before repinning UpstreamDrift.

clusters.rationale: Route uniqueness, WebSocket lifecycle, quota, authentication, diagnostics, and CORS failures share the server contract boundary.
clusters.exit_criteria: Every selected API test passes with fail-closed security behavior and stable route/WebSocket contracts.
clusters.blocking_status: Repair in focused API tranches because several tests exercise shared security invariants.

clusters.rationale: Solver envelopes, result schemas, ranking, rendering, and GUI presentation drifted across one vertical feature.
clusters.exit_criteria: Solver and workbench tests pass using real model outputs, explicit calibration limits, and no fabricated ranking or carry claim.
clusters.blocking_status: Requires coordinated headless-model and presenter repair while preserving scientific limitations.

clusters.owner: Motion pipeline, model-explorer, and scientific-UI maintainers
clusters.rationale: Pose, motion-source, model composition, visualization, and embed-adapter failures cross the canonical motion and UI boundaries.
clusters.exit_criteria: Selected tests pass with canonical pose/source contracts, deterministic persistence, and headless-safe UI imports.
clusters.blocking_status: Split repairs by canonical data contract before changing presenters or optional GUI behavior.

clusters.rationale: Engine adapters, pendulum mechanics, impact, inertia, reinforcement learning, and simulation validation require common physical contracts and explicit tolerances.
clusters.exit_criteria: Selected tests pass with source-backed constants, cross-engine tolerances, and no weakened scientific gate.
clusters.blocking_status: Requires focused engine/model tranches; do not convert missing governed evidence into passing synthetic claims.

clusters.rationale: Processing results, transformations, signal calculus, filtering, noise, limits, and output orchestration share typed numerical data contracts.
clusters.exit_criteria: Selected tests pass with typed results, deterministic numerics, and explicit invalid-input contracts.
clusters.blocking_status: Repair shared result schemas before updating downstream callers.

clusters.rationale: Build hooks, packaging, vendoring, workflow, release, and repository-hygiene tests protect the same provenance and delivery boundary.
clusters.exit_criteria: Selected tests pass with pinned provenance, truthful release artifacts, and unchanged protected-CI guarantees.
clusters.blocking_status: Coordinate cross-repository ownership before changing build or vendor contracts.

clusters.rationale: Security ratchets, optimized-Python guards, safe evaluation, subprocess handling, type stubs, and invariant behavior form the fail-closed core contract.
clusters.exit_criteria: Selected tests pass under normal and optimized Python without weakening validation, security, or type contracts.
clusters.blocking_status: Treat guard and security failures as implementation defects, not candidates for broader suppression.

clusters.rationale: Teleoperation, device state, provider availability, and deployment configuration share environment and runtime-availability contracts.
clusters.exit_criteria: Selected tests pass with explicit runtime availability and deterministic device/teleoperation state transitions.
clusters.blocking_status: Requires environment-contract repair; unavailable external runtimes must continue to fail or skip honestly.
